radius.$description: The brand's language is square and chamfered (corners are cut, not rounded), so the default radius is 0. Every non-zero step must justify itself in its own description.

none.$description: The default. Buttons, cards, panels and inputs are square; emphasis comes from the chamfer, not from rounding (sizes and the clip-path pattern: tokens/chamfer.json).

sm.$description: Justified exception: anti-aliasing softness on small inline elements such as code spans and keyboard hints, where a hard 0 corner looks jagged at 12 px. Never on buttons, cards or panels.

full.$description: Justified exception: genuinely circular shapes only (status dots, avatars). Never a pill-shaped button; the chamfer is the brand's shape.
